records.label: G6
records.fails_if: Any exon's residue range differs, or any anchor lands in a different exon. The difference is investigated; either side may be wrong. A difference traced to a different transcript or assembly on the archive's side is recorded and dismissed, not tuned away

control.fault: exon 17's first residue moved by one

records.why_withheld: its `observed` holds a local drive path to the earlier version's file, inside the record's content digest, so it cannot be cleaned under its id
records.compared_with: the exon table of an earlier version of this project (July 2026), which is not public

records.label: A7
records.fails_if: The difference exceeds 0.5 percentage points or 10 pairs, and stated parameter differences don't explain it
records.why_withheld: its `observed` and its method text name a person outside this project and that person's project, inside the record's content digest
records.compared_with: an identity figure recorded on 2026-09-28 by a separate run of the same method, held outside this project

records.label: A11 (rabbit)
